Here’s a quick snapshot of some of the most talked‑about theatrical releases hitting U.S. cinemas around early June 2024:

| Release Date | Title & Genre | Director / Key Cast |
|--------------|---------------|---------------------|
| **May 31**   | *“Oppenheimer”* – Historical drama | Christopher Nolan (dir.) starring Cillian Murphy, Emily Blunt, Matt Damon |
| **Jun 1**    | *“Killers of the Flower Moon”* – Crime‑drama | Martin Scorsese (dir.) featuring Leonardo DiCaprio, Robert De Niro, Lily Gladstone |
| **Jun 5**    | *“Spider‑Man: Across the Spider‑Verse”* – Animated superhero | Joaquim Dos Santos, Kemp Powers, Justin Kline (directors) voiced by Shameik Moore, Hailee Steinfeld |
| **Jun 7**    | *“Dune: Part Two”* – Sci‑fi epic | Denis Villeneuve (dir.) starring Timothée Chalamet, Zendaya, Rebecca Ferguson |
| **Jun 8**    | *“Mission: Impossible – Dead Reckoning Part One”* – Action thriller | Christopher McQuarrie (dir.) Tom Cruise, Henry Cavill, Vanessa Kirby |
| **Jun 12**   | *“Wonka”* – Family fantasy | Paul King (dir.), Timothée Chalamet as young Willy Wonka |

### Streaming & Home Video Notes  
- Most of these blockbusters will hit major platforms (Disney+, HBO Max, Paramount+) within 30–45 days after their theatrical run ends.  
- “Oppenheimer,” “Killers of the Flower Moon,” and “Dune: Part Two” have already been announced for exclusive digital premieres on Disney+ Hotstar (India), Amazon Prime Video (UK), and Apple TV+ (Australia) respectively.  

If you’re looking for something more niche—independent films, foreign cinema, or limited‑release arthouse pieces—I’d recommend checking out film festivals like Sundance or Cannes’ official selections, many of which get wider distribution later this year. Let me know if you'd like details on those!
